title: Automate changelog and onboard orion-lite-8b v1.1
author: Asha Menon
description:
Onboard orion-lite-8b v1.1 with automated changelog generation and add validated performance profiles for common serving scenarios. Motivation: reduce manual errors in release notes, ensure perf profiles are reproducible across infra changes, and surface perf regressions early via a lightweight CI perf-smoke job.

What this PR does:
- Adds canonical model metadata (models/orion-lite-8b/v1.1/metadata.yaml) with versioned fields, quantization recommendations, supported sequences and batching hints.
- Adds performance profiles (models/orion-lite-8b/v1.1/perf-profile.json) covering seq lengths {64,128,512} and batch sizes {1,4,8} with measured tokens/sec and memory footprints observed on our CI reference instance (A100-80GB).
- Adds an automation script (tools/changelog/auto_changelog.py) that consumes perf test results and releases a changelog entry fragment into changelogs/_pending/orion-lite-8b-v1.1.md.
- Introduces a lightweight CI workflow (ci/perf-lite.yml) that runs a smoke perf test against a containerized reference runner on PRs touching perf metadata. The job is lightweight by design (short sequence lengths + reduced steps) to keep feedback fast.
- Updates docs (docs/models/orion-lite-8b.md) and the model index to include v1.1 metadata and a short migration note for customers pinning to v1.0.

Checklist:
- [x] metadata YAML added and schema-validated
- [x] perf profile generated and committed (values annotated with measurement timestamps)
- [x] changelog automation added with tests
- [x] CI workflow added and green in this branch
- [x] docs updated with migration note

Notes on approach and trade-offs:
- Perf-profile values are measured on the CI reference hardware and include a small safety margin; these are intended as guidance for routing/instance selection and not strict SLAs.
- The changelog automation generates draft fragments; releases are still reviewed by the release manager before publishing to the public changelog.
- The perf-lite CI job intentionally runs a minimal test matrix to avoid flakiness and reduce cost; a separate nightly bench job will run the full matrix for canonical measurements.

Related: ENG-4729 tracks broader perf-profile validation work and PM-1022 is the product ticket for the orion-lite v1.1 roll-out.
